prompt: Add a search box that filters cards by title, and a "Clear filters" button that resets the search and also the label and assignee filters.
result_text:
I added a search box and a "Clear filters" button to the header. I haven't run the server or opened the page. The only check was `node --check` on `public/app.js`, which passed.

- **Search:** Typing in the box filters cards by title as you type. It is case-insensitive and matches any part of the title. It combines with the label and assignee filters, so a card must pass all three to show.
- **Clear filters:** The button empties the search box and sets the label and assignee filters back to "All" and "Everyone".
- **Column badges:** They show the filtered count, as they already did for the other filters.

The changes are in `public/index.html`, `public/app.js` and `public/style.css`. No server changes were needed.
